# 1 Enoch Chapter 38 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**38:1** The-first-parable. When the-congregation of-the-righteous shall-appear, and-sinners shall-be-judged for-their-sins, and-shall-be-driven-from-the-face of-the-dry-ground:

**38:2** And-when the-Righteous-One shall-appear before the-eyes of-the-elect: those-whose-works are-weighed by-the-Lord of-Spirits, and-light shall-appear to-the-righteous and-the-elect who-dwell on-the-dry-ground, where-then will-be the-dwelling-place of-the-sinners, and-where the-resting-place of-those-who-have-denied the-Lord of-Spirits? It-would-have-been-better for-them if-they-had-not-been-born.

**38:3** When the-secrets of-the-Righteous-One are-revealed, he-shall-judge the-sinners, and-the-wicked ones will-not-be-able to-behold-the-face of-the-holy-ones, for-the-light of-the-Lord of-Spirits will-be-seen upon the-face of-the-holy, the-righteous, and-the-elect.

**38:4** And-the-kings and-the-mighty will-at-that-time perish, and-will-be-given-into the-hands of-the-righteous and-the-holy.

**38:5** And-from-that-time none-will-seek-for-themselves mercy from-the-Lord of-Spirits, for-their-life will-be-at-an-end.

**38:6** And-it-shall-come-to-pass in-those-days that-they will-not-be-able to-be-saved by-gold and-silver; and-none-will-be-able to-escape. And-there-will-be-no-iron for-war, nor-a-breastplate for-battle; bronze-will-be-of-no-avail, and-tin-will-be-of-no-avail, and-lead-will-not-be-desired. And-all-these-things will-be-rejected and-destroyed from-the-surface of-the-earth when-the-Elect-One shall-appear before the-face of-the-Lord of-Spirits.

---

*EMET notes: Ch. 38 opens the First Parable (chs. 38–44). The "Righteous One" (v. 2) and "Elect One" (v. 6) appear to be identical — the transcendent figure introduced more fully in ch. 46. The catalog of metals (iron, bronze, tin, lead) echoes Dan 2 and anticipates the metals vision of ch. 52.*
